name: GGUF MXFP4_MOE (llama.cpp MoE-specific ftype: MXFP4 for experts, Q8_0 for everything else)
bits: MXFP4 (4-bit E2M1 + shared E8M0 scale) on expert tensors, Q8_0 on non-expert tensors
activation_scheme: none - weight-only; activations promoted to q8_K/q8_0 for the dot product
notes:
ADDED FOR COVERAGE: llama.cpp ships LLAMA_FTYPE_MOSTLY_MXFP4_MOE as a distinct ftype and this repo had MXFP4 records but no record for the MoE-specific variant, which is the form most current MoE GGUF conversions actually produce.

THE MAPPING, from src/llama-quant.cpp verbatim: `if (ftype == LLAMA_FTYPE_MOSTLY_MXFP4_MOE) { new_type = GGML_TYPE_Q8_0; }` in the output-tensor branch, and in the main branch 'MoE tensors -> MXFP4 / other tensors -> Q8_0', with the expert test being explicit about 3-D tensors and BailingMoE3: 'MLA projection tensors are also 3D, so match expert tensor roles explicitly' via `tensor->ne[2] > 1 && (arch != LLM_ARCH_BAILINGMOE3 || is_bailingmoe3_expert)`.

GROUP SIZE 32 IS THE MX BLOCK, NOT A CHOICE: ggml-common.h defines `#define QK_MXFP4 32` and `block_mxfp4 = { uint8_t e; /* E8M0 */ uint8_t qs[QK_MXFP4/2]; }` - 1 byte shared power-of-two scale plus 16 bytes of packed 4-bit E2M1 for 32 values. This matches the OCP MX definition and the MXFP4 records already in this repo, and unlike GGUF's k-quants there is no separate super-block/scale-group distinction: for MX formats the scale group IS the block.

THE PART THAT ACTUALLY CHANGES THE ARITHMETIC, and the reason this is worth its own record: 'other tensors -> Q8_0' means the embedding, output head, and any non-expert projection are stored at 8.5 bpw while the experts sit at 4.25. So the whole-model bpw of an MXFP4_MOE model is NOT 4.25, and for a model with a large non-expert fraction the gap is material - this is the GGUF-side instance of a pattern already recorded in the k-quant family, where a mixture name silently ships a wider model than its label implies. Note the contrast with the k-quant mixtures, which promote to Q5_K/Q6_K: this one promotes all the way to Q8_0, which is a much larger width gap.

PROXY-FREE: unlike the i-quant records in this repo, scheme 'mxfp4' is EXACTLY right here - MXFP4_MOE is MXFP4, differing only in which tensors receive it. No proxy, no enum change requested.

BACKEND CAVEAT THAT APPLIES AS IT DOES TO EVERY GGUF TYPE HERE: the size-optimized CUDA library shipped in llamafile releases omits the IQ-quant kernels, and no accelerator has a GGUF path in silicon at all, so native_support is deliberately empty.
